mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past three months signals improving labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE declines by >0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based economic recovery, which increases corporate revenue expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 590 and RSAFS > 350000.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO below 95), manufacturing sector weakness reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate lower earnings.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 350,000 million dollars indicates strong consumer demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 350000.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 220.0 (annualized) signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 220.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment (UNRATE) and increases in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate a robust labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 9.5 and PAYEMS > 130000.

mechanism_narrative: In the context of a recovering housing market (HOUST above 600), rising residential investment stimulates construction and related sectors, increasing corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 600.
